history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Door Address Link details.
features: Door Address Link is used by the user to link/de-link Door Address to each PR in a Booking request.
The Booking to be saved with one or more Requirement Details.
The Booking status be in Entered Status or Entry Complete Status.
a) When config ADDRESS_LINK_FOR_NON_DOOR_REQ is set as Y then Valid PR with status other than cancelled should exist.
b) When config ADDRESS_LINK_FOR_NON_DOOR_REQ is set as N then Valid PR with status other than cancelled should exist and also Transport by to be C - Carrier.
For Delink and Delete: Door address should be linked to PR number.

events.description: Opens the Door Address Link screen of the selected PR in a new tab
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks "Door Address Link"

events.description: Displays the Address fields to enter a door address
Selects the record to be linked to the door address
events.triggered_when: User clicks the check box in the Link column after entering the address details

events.description: Enables the address fields for editing and the Delink column
Selects the linked record to be delinked
events.triggered_when: User clicks the check box in the Delink column after clicking Edit

events.description: Saves the door address. Link: links the door address to the selected PR Numbers; the Link column is disabled and the link icon is shown. Delink: delinks the door address from the selected PR Numbers; the Delink column is disabled and the link icon is removed. Edit: saves the edited address details
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after selecting records in the Link column, selecting records in the Delink column, or editing the address fields
events.remarks: Link: "Door Address has been added Successfully!"; Delink: "PR Delinked to Door Address Successfully."; Edit: "Record has been updated successfully"

events.description: Cancels the add/edit and keeps the saved door address
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel while adding or editing
User clicks Delete after selecting records with the row check boxes
events.remarks: "Are you sure you want to delete this record?"

events.description: Deletes the door address of the selected records; the deleted record is removed
events.triggered_when: User clicks Yes in the confirmation alert
User clicks No in the confirmation alert

events.description: Generates TOPS for the selected Port Releases
events.triggered_when: User selects records and clicks the ☰ menu on the tab >> Generate TOPS
events.remarks: "TOPS Generated for selected Port Release(s) Successfully."

events.description: Generates Nomination for the selected Port Releases
events.triggered_when: User selects records and clicks the ☰ menu on the tab >> Generate Nomination
events.remarks: "Nomination Generated for selected Port Release(s) Successfully."
